title: External scripts, defer, modules
learningObjectives: Explain external scripts, defer, modules and create a small runnable JavaScript example.

understand.concept: External scripts use the src attribute. A classic script with defer downloads in parallel and executes after parsing, in document order. A module script uses type=module, is deferred by default, and supports import/export. async scripts execute as soon as downloaded and do not guarantee order.
understand.whyItMatters: Choosing the loading mode prevents code from running before required markup or dependencies are ready. Modules also use strict mode and have their own scope and loading rules.
understand.analogy: defer waits for the document to be parsed; async runs when ready; modules provide an organised import/export system.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; script loading and JavaScript evaluation follow browser parsing and language rules.

explain.narrative: The first external classic script is deferred. The second loads as a module and is deferred by default.

examples.explanation: The first external classic script is deferred. The second loads as a module and is deferred by default.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser page or developer console shows the result described in the example.

practise.guidedTask: Create two small scripts and compare defer, async, and type=module. Explain which ordering guarantees each provides.
practise.independentTask: Create a small page with an external or embedded script. Test its execution order and inspect the console for errors.
hints: Keep behaviour separate from semantic markup where practical.
Choose defer, async, or module based on dependencies and ordering.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>External scripts, defer, modules</title></head><body>
<script defer src='app.js'></script>
<script type='module' src='main.js'></script>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which script type supports import and export and is deferred by default?
questions.explanation: JavaScript modules support import/export and defer execution until parsing is complete.

questions.prompt: What is a useful way to diagnose a JavaScript runtime issue?
options: Inspect the console and source location
questions.answer: Inspect the console and source location
questions.explanation: Developer tools show runtime messages and help locate the source of an issue.
